name: art-auction-house
description: A real-time auction marketplace for original art.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api -w server" "npm run dev:worker -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run infra:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed:if-empty -w server && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
